what_was_done: The D33-13 upstream command is fixed: it prints 'git branch --set-upstream-to=<remote>/<branch> <branch>' and test_target_head_local_and_pr runs it. The not_descendant remedy is still unworkable in the common case, where the story worktree exists (create_story's path-exists branch, lines 262-268). There it prints 'delete the branch (git branch -D story/<id>), then admit the story again', and git refuses: reproduced in a scratch copy, 'error: cannot delete branch 'story/S-9.01' used by worktree at .../.worktrees/S-9.01', exit 1. test_verify_story_refusals only asserts the text is present and never runs it. The remedy works only in the no-worktree branch (lines 270-276).
